name: Wild Blackberry
descriptions: A plump, ink-dark jewel still dusted with a fine, silvery bloom from the morning dew.
Its skin is tight and glistening, promising a burst of tart sweetness at the slightest pressure.
effects: Your teeth sink into the soft, yielding fruit, releasing a sudden flood of warm, dark nectar.
A stained sweetness coats your tongue, leaving a hint of sun-warmed brambles in its wake.

name: Golden Husked Cob
descriptions: A warm, heavy weight resting in your palms, still carrying the faint scent of sun-drenched earth and morning dew.
Individual kernels cling to the core like tiny, glistening amber beads, tightly wrapped in soft, pale silk.
effects: You tear through the papery outer layers to reveal the sweet, bright treasure hidden within.
The crunch of the golden kernels releases a burst of starchy, earthy sweetness on your tongue.

name: Aloe Leaf
descriptions: A thick, fleshy spear of verdant green, still cool from the morning dew.
Its skin is waxy and taut, hiding a translucent, soothing essence within its jagged edges.
Heavy with moisture, it feels substantial and life-giving in your palm.
effects: You bite into the cool, gelatinous center, feeling an immediate rush of moisture soothing your throat.
The mild, slightly bitter gel slides down, leaving your mouth feeling refreshed and calm.

name: Kale Leaf Bunch
descriptions: A dense collection of deep emerald fronds, still weeping with morning dew.
The texture is rugged and curly, feeling cool and crisp against your fingertips.
effects: You tear a jagged piece away, feeling the snap of fresh fiber.
The earthy, slightly bitter moisture coats your tongue.

name: Sun-Kissed Watermelon Seed
descriptions: A tiny, obsidian-like teardrop, slick with the residue of sweet summer nectar.
You hold a small, dark vessel of potential, still warm from the heavy humidity of a mid-July afternoon.
effects: You bite into the hard casing, feeling the dry, gritty texture against your teeth.
A flash of bitterness hits your tongue as you struggle with the unyielding, woody shell.

name: Golden Kernel Spark
descriptions: A tiny, sun-drenched treasure nestled within a papery, translucent husk.
The warmth of a midsummer afternoon captured in a singular, hard speck of amber.
effects: You bite into the hard, unyielding grain, feeling its jagged edges scrape against your teeth.
A dry, starchy powder coats your tongue, instantly stealing every drop of moisture from your mouth.
The flavor is dull and earthy, leaving you craving a cool drink.

name: Aloe Pup
descriptions: A tiny, succulent sprout with fleshy, translucent green leaves that feel cool to the touch.
A miniature marvel, brimming with life and ready to nestle into a ceramic pot.
effects: You bite into the thick, gelatinous center of the leaf, feeling a burst of cold moisture that quickly turns to a gritty, unpleasant texture in your mouth.

name: Tarnished Blackberry Seed
descriptions: A tiny, dark speck of potential nestled within a dusty, linen pouch.
Biting into this raw seed offers nothing but a gritty sensation against your teeth.
effects: You crunch down on the hard, miniature core, feeling its sharp edges scrape against your palate.
The dry, earthy taste lingers on your tongue, leaving you yearning for a cool drink.

name: Kale Seed
descriptions: A tiny, crinkled speck of potential, resting within a worn burlap pouch.
It holds the promise of deep forest hues and crisp, morning-dew textures.
effects: You bite into the hard, dry casing, feeling only a gritty residue on your tongue.
Your throat feels parched as the tiny husk scrapes against your palate.

name: Blackberry Cane Cutting
descriptions: You hold a supple, dark emerald stem that still drips with the morning dew. Its tiny, sharp thorns gently prick your thumb, a tactile reminder of the wild thicket it calls home.
The wood feels sturdy and alive in your hands, fragrant with a deep, sweet musk that suggests a summer bounty yet to come.

name: Whole Watermelon
descriptions: A heavy, sun-warmed sphere with a thick, striped rind, still smelling of damp earth and morning dew.
You run your hands over the cool, waxy surface, feeling the immense weight of the juice held within.
effects: You bite into the crisp, sugary flesh and feel a cool rush of sweetness flood your mouth.
The refreshing juice drips down your chin, washing away the heat of the afternoon sun.
